name: assistant-ui
summary: Open-source React primitives and shadcn registry for production AI chat UIs.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 high-signal registry comps with HTTP 200 on r.assistant-ui.com — not full elements inventory (~150 element pages).
Optional Assistant Cloud is a separate paid SaaS (Free/Pro plans); open-source UI comps remain free MIT — Cloud not ingested.
Many comps need AssistantRuntimeProvider / @assistant-ui/react context to render beyond static docs demos.
Style-aware registry also at https://r.assistant-ui.com/styles/{style}/{name}.json and /base/{name}.json; catalog uses plain r.assistant-ui.com/{name}.json.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Thread
components.summary: Main AI chat thread with messages, composer, and tool/reasoning slots.

demo.peerNotes: requires @assistant-ui/react runtime context for most comps

components.copyCode:
npx assistant-ui@latest add thread

# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://r.assistant-ui.com/thread.json
# or with components.json registries.@assistant-ui configured:
# npx shadcn@latest add @assistant-ui/thread
# Lands under components/assistant-ui/elements/ (see registry JSON).

<Thread />

copyPrompt.text: Use assistant-ui free MIT component `Thread` (slug `thread`) from https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements/thread. Install with `npx assistant-ui@latest add thread` or `npx shadcn@latest add https://r.assistant-ui.com/thread.json` (or `npx shadcn@latest add @assistant-ui/thread` when `@assistant-ui` registry is configured to `https://r.assistant-ui.com/styles/{style}/{name}.json` or plain `https://r.assistant-ui.com/{name}.json`). Registry item: https://r.assistant-ui.com/thread.json. Requires React/Next + `@assistant-ui/react` peers. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 AgentbaseAI Inc.). Pricing free for open-source components (optional Assistant Cloud SaaS separate).
